async def act(page):
    # Filter to show only 'enhancement' labeled issues (feature requests)
    filter_group = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=page.get_by_role("button", name="Toggle history"))
    filter_textbox = filter_group.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search or filter results...")
    await filter_textbox.fill("label:enhancement")
    await filter_textbox.press("Enter")
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Collect all issue links under the main area that have 'enhancement' label
    main_area = page.get_by_role("main")
    # Get all link elements under main that are issue links (they have URLs starting with '/root/metaseq/-/issues/')
    # We'll filter by checking if they have a child group with role 'group' and name 'Labels' containing a link with name 'enhancement'
    issue_links = []
    all_links = await main_area.get_by_role("link").all()
    for link in all_links:
        href = await link.get_attribute("href")
        if href and href.startswith("/root/metaseq/-/issues/") and not href.endswith("#notes"):
            # Check if this link has a sibling group with label 'enhancement'
            # In the tree, each issue link is followed by a group 'Labels' with a link for the label
            # We can use the parent context to find the group relative to this link
            # Since the structure is flat under main, we can look for a group with name 'Labels' that contains a link 'enhancement' near this link
            # A simpler approach: filter links that have a following sibling group with the enhancement label
            # Use page context to find groups with role 'group' and name 'Labels' that have a link 'enhancement'
            label_groups = page.get_by_role("group", name="Labels").filter(has=page.get_by_role("link", name="enhancement"))
            # Check if this link is associated with such a label group (they are siblings in the tree)
            # We'll assume if the link is in the same issue item, it will be near the label group
            # Since we can't directly traverse siblings with get_by_role, we'll collect all enhancement-labeled issue titles by scanning
            # Instead, let's get all issue titles from links that are enhancement-labeled by checking the text after filtering
            # Since we filtered with 'label:enhancement', all visible issue links should be enhancement-labeled
            # So we can just get all issue links after filtering
            issue_links.append(link)
    # After filtering, get the text of each issue link
    issue_titles = []
    for link in issue_links:
        title = await link.text_content()
        if title:
            issue_titles.append(title)
    # Return the list of issue titles
    return issue_titles
